name: Walk
description: A captured straight walking take at its original pace.

name: Walk and turns
description: A continuous captured performance with repeated walks and turns.

name: Run
description: A captured forward run at its original pace.

name: Walk and stop
description: A slow walking performance that decelerates and settles on both feet.

name: Run and stop
description: A running performance with a recorded recovery step and standing finish.

name: Standing idle
description: A quiet recorded standing performance with small shifts of weight, at its original 60 Hz pace.

name: Walking with a gradual stop
description: An original walking performance that slows over several steps and settles into standing.

name: Running pass
description: A captured straight running pass at its original pace.

name: Stand, walk, and stop
description: A continuous standing start, walking turns, and settled finish at the recorded pace.

name: Waiting
description: Stands and waits, shifting weight and glancing around.

name: Stretch and yawn
description: Raises both arms in a stretch and yawns.

name: Mope
description: Walks off slowly with a dejected posture.

name: Pacing
description: Paces back and forth while thinking.

name: Waiting for the bus
description: A long, natural wait: weight shifts, looks around, small fidgets.

name: Wave hello
description: Raises the right hand and waves hello.

name: Waving
description: A longer, energetic wave.

name: Shrug
description: Shrugs the shoulders with open hands.

name: High five
description: Steps in and gives a high five.

name: Shake hands
description: Steps forward and offers a handshake.

name: Curtsey
description: A low curtsey.

name: Bow
description: Bows from the waist and straightens up.

name: Peekaboo
description: Covers the face with both hands and reveals it.

name: Teaching
description: A long explanation with natural hand gestures, as when teaching a class.

name: Arguing
description: Argues with emphatic arm gestures.

name: Answer the phone
description: Picks up an imagined phone and talks. No phone is included.

name: Very happy
description: Shows great joy with the whole body.

name: Laughing
description: Laughs, doubling over.

name: Sad
description: Shows sadness with slumped posture.

name: Crying
description: Cries with hands to the face.

name: Scared
description: Startles and shrinks back in fear.

name: Upset
description: Shows frustration and anger.

name: Cold
description: Shivers and rubs the arms against the cold.

name: Sit down
description: Sits down onto a chair behind. With a seat chosen, the body is placed on it.

name: Stand up
description: Rises from a chair to standing.

name: Sit down and get up
description: Sits on a low seat and stands again, twice.

name: Sit on a stool
description: Perches on a high stool and gets up.

name: Sitting in a chair
description: Sits down, settles, shifts and gets up again.

name: High stool, sit and stand
description: Sits on a high stool and stands, several times.

name: Walk and pick up a box
description: Walks over, squats and lifts a box. No box is included.

name: Pick up from the floor
description: Bends down to the floor and picks something up.

name: Pick up
description: Reaches down and picks something up. With a prop chosen, the hand takes it.

name: Put down
description: Sets a glass down in front. With a prop chosen, the hand places it.

name: Sipping coffee
description: Holds a cup and takes several sips. No cup is included.

name: Take a sip
description: Raises a drink and sips. With a cup chosen, the hand holds it.

name: Drink a soda
description: Drinks from a bottle. No bottle is included.

name: Up and down a short ladder
description: Climbs a few rungs and comes back down.

name: Climb a ladder
description: Climbs up a ladder. With a ladder chosen, the hands and feet hold its rungs.

name: Crawl
description: Gets down and crawls on hands and knees.

name: Forward jump
description: Crouches and jumps forward.

name: Jump up
description: Jumps straight up for height.

name: Twist dance
description: Dances the twist.

name: Macarena
description: Dances the Macarena.

name: Chicken dance
description: Dances the chicken dance.

name: Modern dance
description: Expressive modern dance with a pirouette.

name: Casual walk
description: An unhurried walk.

name: Walk backwards
description: Walks backwards.

name: Walk sideways
description: Side-steps.

name: Sneak
description: Sneaks on bent knees.

name: Stealthy walk
description: Walks stealthily around a space.

name: Sad walk
description: A slow walk with dropped shoulders.

name: Limp
description: Limps on a hurt right leg.

name: Walk up steps
description: Walks up a few steps and over. No steps are included.

name: Run to a stop
description: Runs and stops.

name: Start running
description: Starts from standing into a run.

name: Wandering walk
description: Walks around at random.

name: Write on a board
description: Writes on a chalkboard. No board is included.

name: Type on a laptop
description: Types on an imagined laptop held in front.

name: Wash a window
description: Wipes a window in front.

name: Sweep
description: Sweeps the floor with a broom. No broom is included.

name: Channel surfing
description: Points a remote at a TV, changing channels.

name: Punching
description: Throws a series of punches.

name: Kicking
description: Throws a series of kicks.

name: Get up from lying face down
description: Pushes up from the floor to standing.

name: Get up from the ground
description: Gets up from the ground to standing.

name: Talk
description: Talks with natural hand gestures.
